points.text: M1: diagram showing minimum of 4 particles (in total in 2 rows)
points.guidance: circles containing $\mathrm{X}^{n+}$ do not have to be labelled; circle containing + must be labelled as 'ion' OR empty circles / circles with X must be labelled + ion / positive ion / cation / $\mathrm{X}^{n+}$ AND with the circles surrounded by electrons shown as $\mathrm{e^-}$ / - OR little circles labelled electrons

points.text: M2: label / legend showing delocalised electrons
M1: reagent = any named / formula of soluble sulfate OR $\mathrm{H_2SO_4}$ OR any named / formula of soluble hydroxide
M2: $\mathrm{BaSO_4}$ insoluble (& $\mathrm{MgSO_4}$ soluble) OR ($\mathrm{Ba(OH)_2}$ soluble &) $\mathrm{Mg(OH)_2}$ insoluble

white precipitate ; yellow solid ; (dark) grey solid / purple gas

effervescence / misty fumes ; rotten egg smell
points.guidance: Published scheme lists these observations together in a 2-mark block; no separate M1/M2 allocation is printed.

points.text: M2: moles of $\mathbf{X} = 1/2 \times$ moles of $\mathrm{AgNO_3} = 0.250 \div M_r(\mathbf{X})$ $\therefore M_r(\mathbf{X}) = 297.2$
M3: $A_r$ of Group 2 element is $297.2 - 2(79.9) = 137.4$ AND $\mathbf{X}$ is $\mathrm{BaBr_2}$
